dct_description_sm: A conceptual depiction of the YorkNet UBF Project planned last mile route. The line work is based on road centreline and is for planning purposes only as it represents the original vision of the planned expansion of fibre routes (pre design / construct). The last mile represents the section of route where connections to eligible homes can be made.
